"""Highbar control episode driver for the eai-standard/2.1 RCB service.
Run once against the live episode; never resets. Saves concise observations to output/.
"""
import json, time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver

OUT = Path('/app/output')
DT = 0.02
CAM = ['room_camera']

def save_observation(r, tag):
    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=CAM, video='none')
    try:
        from PIL import Image
        Image.fromarray(obs.last['room_camera']).save(OUT / f'{tag}.png')
    except Exception:
        pass
    print(json.dumps({'tag': tag, 'meta': obs.meta, 'proprio': obs.meta.get('proprio', {}).get('now')}), flush=True)
    return obs

if __name__ == '__main__':
    r = Robot()
    s = r.spec()
    (OUT / 'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(s, indent=2))
    print('status', json.dumps(r.status()), flush=True)
    save_observation(r, 'initial')
    print('Control policy has not yet been selected.', flush=True)
PY

"""One-episode highbar driver; all poses are joint angles in radians.
Run with --steps N and optional hip/knee/shoulder values to continue the live episode.
It never calls reset and records every command/result under /app/output.
"""
import argparse, json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver

OUT=Path('/app/output')

def pose(hip=0.0, knee=0.0, ankle=0.0, shoulder_pitch=0.0, elbow=1.49):
    q=np.zeros(19,dtype=np.float32)
    q[2]=q[7]=hip; q[3]=q[8]=knee; q[4]=q[9]=ankle
    q[11]=q[15]=shoulder_pitch
    q[12]=3.11; q[13]=0.0; q[14]=elbow
    q[16]=-3.11; q[17]=0.0; q[18]=elbow
    return q

def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument('--steps',type=int,default=40)
    ap.add_argument('--hip',type=float,default=-2.5)
    ap.add_argument('--knee',type=float,default=0.05)
    ap.add_argument('--ankle',type=float,default=0.1)
    ap.add_argument('--shoulder-pitch',type=float,default=1.5)
    ap.add_argument('--elbow',type=float,default=1.49)
    ap.add_argument('--note',default='')
    args=ap.parse_args()
    r=Robot(); spec=r.spec(); rg=np.asarray(spec['action_types']['joint_position']['range_rad'],dtype=np.float32)
    before=r.status(); q=pose(args.hip,args.knee,args.ankle,args.shoulder_pitch,args.elbow)
    action=2*(q-rg[:,0])/(rg[:,1]-rg[:,0])-1
    n=max(1,min(args.steps,500))
    result=r.submit('joint_position',np.repeat(action[None,:],n,axis=0),dt=spec['control_dt'],interpolate='hold',cameras=['room_camera'],video='none',note=args.note)
    p=np.asarray(result.meta['proprio']['now'])
    step=result.meta.get('control_steps',0)
    Image.fromarray(result.last['room_camera']).save(OUT/f'room_{step:04d}.png')
    entry={'before':before,'command':vars(args),'after':{k:result.meta.get(k) for k in ('control_steps','done','reason','sim_time_s','executed_rows','clipped')},'q_rad':p[:19].tolist(),'imu':p[-6:].tolist()}
    with (OUT/'control_log.jsonl').open('a') as f: f.write(json.dumps(entry)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(entry),flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__': main()
PY
